Name: Employment → Consumer Distress
Pathway: Job loss → Income stop → Savings depleted (0-21 days for bottom quintile) → Missed payment → Delinquency

Name: Consumer Distress → Bank NCOs
Pathway: Missed payment → 30-day DQ → 60-day → 90-day → Charge-off → Bank NCO → Earnings miss
Notes: CC first (lowest priority), then auto, then mortgage

Name: Latent → Actual Conversion
Pathway: Latent vulnerability + Trigger event → Instant distress → Delinquency → Default
Notes: Double trigger: leverage + liquidity shock = 100% conversion

Name: Phantom Debt Acceleration
Trigger: Employment shock to BNPL/cash advance users
Pathway: Hidden debt service → Employment shock → Cash flow collapse → Faster conversion than models predict

Name: FL Employment → Housing
Pathway: State layoffs → Income loss → Mortgage stress → Foreclosure filing → Housing price pressure → Bank CRE/resi exposure

Name: CA Fire → Foreclosure
Trigger: Major fire event in uninsured zones
Pathway: Fire event → Uninsured loss → Mortgage default → Mass foreclosure → Regional bank exposure

Name: Payment Hierarchy Cascade
Pathway: Job loss → CC missed first → Auto missed (if prolonged) → Mortgage missed (last resort) → Foreclosure
Notes: CC delinquency is early warning for downstream stress

Name: Minimum Payment → Default Wave
Trigger: Min payment rate sustained at highs
Pathway: Zombie borrowers (min payment only) → Interest accrual → Balance growth → Any shock → Instant default
Notes: Zombie population 20-30% larger than measured (phantom debt)

Name: Medical Event → Financial Crisis
Pathway: Medical event → Deductible due → Can't pay → Medical debt → Credit score drop → Higher rates → Cascade

Name: Caregiver Multiplier
Pathway: Health shock → Caregiver reduces hours → Income drops 50% MORE than patient's contribution → Double shock

Name: Severance Runway → Claims Spike
Pathway: Layoff announced → Severance accepted → Runway period → Severance exhausted → UI claim filed → Consumer stress visible
Notes: Why stress looks delayed - severance masks timing

Name: REGINALD Feedback → CARL Tightening
Pathway: Bank stress → Credit tightening → Refinance unavailable → Trapped borrowers → Forced default
